timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: This breakup still feels raw.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind keeps returning to memories.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I do not know how to picture life without them.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I keep looking for reasons this happened.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels heavy with this loss.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want the ache to stop right now.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me feels like I will always feel this way.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I am heartbroken.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This is a lot to hold right now.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can let this hurt exist without rushing it.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Memories do not mean I made the wrong choice by feeling them.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I only need to get through today.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I do not have to understand everything right now.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can soften even while it grieves.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: This feeling will not stay this intense forever.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am allowed to fall apart a little before I rebuild.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can be gentle with myself through this.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let today be enough.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I trust myself to get through this.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I am still whole, even while I am healing.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can imagine a future, even without seeing it clearly yet.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can be patient with my own timeline.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can find moments of relief.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am allowed to feel okay again, slowly.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: This ending is not the end of me.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I am capable of healing at my own pace.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to take this one day at a time.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
